Name: Mortar SMAPI Bridge
Author: AlbinoStoic
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Mortar SMAPI Bridge lets the [url=https://github.com/Rethunk-Tech/mortar]Mortar[/url] mod manager send SMAPI console commands to a running Stardew Valley, so Mortar can reload or configure mods without you typing in the SMAPI console. It adds no gameplay and changes no game content.


[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list]
[*]If you use Mortar, you do not need to download this: Mortar installs and updates it for you.[/*]
[*]By hand: install SMAPI, then unzip the download into the game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder, so the [font=Courier New]MortarSmapiBridge[/font] folder sits inside it.[/*]
[/list]

[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Runs the SMAPI console commands Mortar sends, exactly as if you typed them in the SMAPI console.[/*]
[*]Optional stream overlay for OBS, off by default; it has its own token and no path to the command channel.[/*]
[*]Listens on [font=Courier New]127.0.0.1[/font] only (never the network, never the internet), and every request needs a random token stored in a file only your user can read. It makes no outgoing connections.[/*]
[/list]

[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 or a later 4.x. On SMAPI 5, or a 4.x whose internal console queue moved, the command channel stays off and logs a warning.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later. The stream overlay runs on 1.6.14 up to, but not including, 1.7; on any other game version it stays off.[/*]
[/list]

[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
